def: A piece shaped like a knee; as, the kneepieces or ears of aboat.
The seed of a Brazilian lauraceous tree (Nectandra Puchury) ofa taste and smell between those of nutmeg and of sassafras, --sometimes used medicinally. Called also sassafras nut.

A personal satire in writing; usually, malicious and abusivecensure written only to reproach and distress.Like her who missed her name in a lampoon, And grieved to findherself decayed so soon. Dryden.
Mud or fine earth deposited from running or standing water.
A cellular layer derived from the nucleus of an ovule andsurrounding the embryo sac. Cf. Quintine.
A kind of notary public, or attorney, in the Levant.
A platform; the bottom of a room; a floor; pavement. See Floor,n. Addison.
A man who manages, or waits on, an engine.
Manner of linking or of being linked; -- said of the union ofatoms or radicals in the molecule.
Disgrace; infamy; reproach mingled with contempt; abusivelanguage.Being both dramatic author and dramatic performer, he found himselfheir to a twofold opprobrium. De Quincey.
